material_note: Spot/Scan on Bare Metal files are Ti-6Al-4V (NIST SRM 654b). The Al_* challenge tables are results for aluminium (NIST SRM 1241c) from the A-AMB2022-01 challenge and are not Ti-6Al-4V.
title: Asynchronous AM Bench 2022 Challenge Data: Real-time, simultaneous absorptance and high-speed Xray imaging
citation: Simonds, Brian J, Tanner, Jack, Artusio-Glimpse, Alexandra, Williams, Paul A., Parab, Niranjan, Zhao, Cang, Sun, Tao (2022), Asynchronous AM Bench 2022 Challenge Data: Real-time, simultaneous absorptance and high-speed x-ray imaging, Version 1.0.0, National Institute of Standards and Technology, https://doi.org/10.18434/mds2-2525
checksum_authority: SHA-256 values published in the NIST NERDm record for ark:/88434/mds2-2525; local bytes recomputed and matched

acquisition.route: Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshots of the NIST download URLs (data.nist.gov timed out on 2026-10-06)
acquisition.note: Each archived file's SHA-256 and byte count match the NERDm record. The NERDm record file is a local re-serialisation (sorted keys, indent 1) and its checksum authority is local.

experiment.laser: 1070 nm Yb-doped fibre laser, galvanometer scanner, 7 degree angle of incidence to the sample surface normal

spot_diameter_1_over_e2_um.note: calculated at the sample surface, 2.8 mm below the beam waist

materials.ti64: Ti-6Al-4V from NIST SRM 654b, wire-EDM machined and polished to ~300 um thickness, specular polished laser-incident surface, bare metal (no powder)
materials.aluminium: NIST SRM 1241c, ~1 mm thick (A-AMB2022-01 challenge results only)

experiment.atmosphere: argon backfilled to room pressure after vacuum pumping
experiment.absorptance_method: calibrated integrating sphere, 1070 nm bandpass photodiode, energy balance between input and backscattered power, zero transmission assumed; calibration repeated between laser exposures; oscilloscope time resolution 40 ns
experiment.xray_imaging: APS 32-ID-B, 50000 frames per second, 2.5 us exposure

aluminium_challenge_values_as_published.statistics: average of 3 runs, value then 1 standard deviation as given by NIST

derived_tables.provenance: locally derived from the files above; not published by NIST; analysis windows are local choices
